strings.zh: 正辉『呀,是{VAR:0103:0}啊！好久不见！{NEWLINE}你这是在城都地区旅行吗？
strings.en: Bill: Hey, it’s {VAR:0103:0}! Long time no{NEWLINE}see! Are you traveling around Johto?

strings.zh: 正辉『那个……{NEWLINE}精灵的传送系统{CLEAR}就是我制作的。{SCROLL}但是呢,那也并不是{NEWLINE}靠我一个人的能力制作出来的。{SCROLL}比如说芳缘地区,你知道么？{SCROLL}住在芳缘的真由美,{NEWLINE}为了让保管系统{CLEAR}使用起来更方便{CLEAR}而将其进行了改良。{SCROLL}就这样,通过{NEWLINE}住在全国各地的同伴们{CLEAR}齐心合力的工作,{SCROLL}用来做精灵的交换{NEWLINE}和保管等功能的系统,{CLEAR}就这样渐渐进化升级了{SCROLL}哎呀,我差不多{NEWLINE}要回满金市了。{CLEAR}常回家看看哦！{SCROLL}拜拜！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Bill: You know... I’m the one who made{NEWLINE}the Pokémon transfer system.{SCROLL}But I couldn’t have built it with my own{NEWLINE}abilities alone.{SCROLL}For example, you know the Hoenn{NEWLINE}region, right?{SCROLL}Lanette, who lives in Hoenn,{NEWLINE}improved the Storage System to make it{CLEAR}easier to use.{SCROLL}That’s how, with friends all over the{NEWLINE}country working together, the system{CLEAR}for trading and storing Pokémon has{CLEAR}kept evolving and getting better.{SCROLL}Oh my, I’d better head back to{NEWLINE}Goldenrod. Be sure to visit home often!{SCROLL}Bye-bye!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0615/1 | rewritten from zh (was us) | US line rewritten: hack adds the Bill: label and the zh ending ‘visit home often’ (US had ‘see my folks’); 真由美 = Lanette

strings.zh: 舞女的身段就算包裹在厚厚的衣服里{NEWLINE}还是那么清晰苗条,{CLEAR}看多了身体真的受不了。
strings.en: Even wrapped in those heavy kimonos,{NEWLINE}the Kimono Girls’ figures are still so{CLEAR}clear and slender. If I watch them too{CLEAR}long, my body really can’t take it.

strings.zh: 缘朱市的馆主小松大人{NEWLINE}真是太出色了！{CLEAR}人长得帅气、打扮得又酷。{SCROLL}而且使用的精灵{NEWLINE}也很强哦~
strings.en: Ecruteak City’s Gym Leader, Morty,{NEWLINE}is soooo amazing! He’s handsome,{CLEAR}and he dresses so cool.{SCROLL}And his Pokémon are really strong, too!

strings.zh: 听说东面卡吉镇的愤怒湖里{NEWLINE}出现了红色的暴鲤龙,{CLEAR}好多游客闻讯都赶去那里看热闹。{CLEAR}可是这种违反自然界常识的现象,{CLEAR}或许是一种不好的兆头。
strings.en: I heard a red Gyarados showed up in{NEWLINE}the Lake of Rage, by Mahogany Town{CLEAR}to the east. Loads of tourists rushed{CLEAR}over to gawk at it.{SCROLL}But something that goes against the{NEWLINE}laws of nature like that might be a{CLEAR}bad omen.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『是啊,没想到会跟你在这巧遇。{NEWLINE}你也是来城都地区旅行的吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yeah, I never{NEWLINE}expected to run into you here.{CLEAR}Are you traveling in Johto too?

strings.zh: 正辉『你身为联盟冠军{NEWLINE}应该也听说了吧,{CLEAR}火箭队最近又开始活动的传闻……
strings.en: Bill: As the League Champion, you must{NEWLINE}have heard the rumors too... that Team{CLEAR}Rocket has started operating again...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可不只是传闻,{NEWLINE}我是真的遇到过几次火箭队。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: They’re not just rumors.{NEWLINE}I’ve actually run into Team Rocket{CLEAR}a few times.

strings.zh: 正辉『所以精灵联盟为了防范{NEWLINE}火箭队使用电脑病毒偷取精灵,{CLEAR}让我对寄存系统进行了升级。{CLEAR}我这次来城都地区{CLEAR}就是为了检查升级完成情况。
strings.en: Bill: That’s why the Pokémon League{NEWLINE}had me upgrade the Storage System,{CLEAR}to stop Team Rocket from stealing{CLEAR}Pokémon with computer viruses.{SCROLL}I came to Johto this time to check how{NEWLINE}the upgrade is going.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这么多城市,{NEWLINE}检查起来可够累人的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: With so many cities,{NEWLINE}checking them all must be exhausting.

strings.zh: 正辉『哈哈,谁说不是呢。{NEWLINE}我现在要赶去满金市了,{CLEAR}等你有空了再来华蓝海角玩啊！
strings.en: Bill: Ha ha, you can say that again.{NEWLINE}I’ve got to hurry to Goldenrod City{CLEAR}now. Come visit me at Cerulean Cape{CLEAR}when you’re free!

strings.zh: 原来卡吉镇的红色暴鲤龙{NEWLINE}是火箭队搞的鬼。{CLEAR}强行榨干精灵的能量让他们进化,{CLEAR}真的是太残忍了。
strings.en: So the red Gyarados in Mahogany{NEWLINE}Town was Team Rocket’s doing.{CLEAR}Forcing Pokémon to evolve by draining{CLEAR}their energy... That’s just too cruel.

strings.zh: 今天铃铛塔不让参观,{NEWLINE}歌舞连乘也没有表演。{CLEAR}感觉来缘朱市旅游的很不是时候。
strings.en: The Bell Tower is closed to visitors{NEWLINE}today, and the Dance Theater has no{CLEAR}performances either. Seems like a really{CLEAR}bad time to visit Ecruteak City.

strings.zh: 就算缘朱市的景点都不开放,{NEWLINE}只要能和她一起出来旅游,{NEWLINE}我就很满足了。
strings.en: Even if none of Ecruteak City’s sights{NEWLINE}are open, I’m perfectly happy as long{CLEAR}as I get to travel with her.

strings.zh: 这只风铃铃是我在铃铛塔附近遇到的,{NEWLINE}它发出的铃铃铃的响声很好听呢。
strings.en: I met this Chimecho near the Bell Tower.{NEWLINE}Its jingling chimes sound so lovely.

strings.zh: 风铃铃『Chiiii——me！
strings.en: Chimecho: Chiiii-me!

strings.en: Exbo: Tyyy-lo!

strings.en: Exbo: Quiii-la!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,我在烧焦塔的时候{NEWLINE}看到吊眼红毛的小锯鳄{CLEAR}已经进化成了大力鳄。{CLEAR}所以我也想给火岩鼠来个特训,{CLEAR}好让它能早点进化。{SCROLL}阿金『偶像你现在有时间的话,{NEWLINE}能跟我来场特训对战吗？
strings.en: Gold: Idol, when I was at the Burned{NEWLINE}Tower, I saw the scowling redhead’s{CLEAR}Totodile had already evolved{CLEAR}into Feraligatr.{SCROLL}So I want to give my Quilava some{NEWLINE}special training, so it can evolve{CLEAR}soon too.{SCROLL}Gold: Idol, if you’ve got time right now,{NEWLINE}will you have a training battle with me?

strings.zh: 阿金『好嘞,阿金的第一次特训对战,{NEWLINE}现在开始！
strings.en: Gold: All right! Gold’s first training{NEWLINE}battle starts now!

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,第二次特训{NEWLINE}就用双打的方式吧！
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh, let’s make the second{NEWLINE}training session a Double Battle!

strings.zh: 阿金『好嘞,阿金的第三次特训对战,{NEWLINE}现在开始！
strings.en: Gold: All right! Gold’s third training{NEWLINE}battle starts now!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像如果没事的话,{NEWLINE}再陪我打几局练一下呗。
strings.en: Gold: Idol, if you’re not busy,{NEWLINE}practice with me a few more rounds.

strings.zh: 阿金『呼,不愧是偶像。{NEWLINE}跟你对战确实能学到很多东西。
strings.en: Gold: Whew, that’s my idol for you.{NEWLINE}I really learn a lot from battling you.

strings.zh: 爆太郎『Quiii——la！{SCROLL}爆太郎的样子……！
strings.en: Exbo: Quiii-la!{SCROLL}Something’s happening to Exbo...!

strings.zh: 爆太郎进化成了火爆兽！
strings.en: Exbo evolved into Typhlosion!

strings.zh: 阿金『哇哇哇！成功了！爆太郎进化了！
strings.en: Gold: Whoa whoa whoa! It worked!{NEWLINE}Exbo evolved!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,这都要多亏你的帮忙,{NEWLINE}如果不是你陪我练习这么多次,{CLEAR}爆太郎也不可能这么快进化。{SCROLL}阿金『练习了这么久,{NEWLINE}偶像应该也出了不少汗,{CLEAR}这个是我在口袋竞技场买的饮料,{CLEAR}偶像你拿去解解渴吧！
strings.en: Gold: Idol, it’s all thanks to you.{NEWLINE}If you hadn’t practiced with me so{CLEAR}many times, Exbo could never have{CLEAR}evolved this fast.{SCROLL}Gold: After all that practice,{NEWLINE}you must’ve worked up a sweat too,{CLEAR}Idol. Here’s a drink I bought{CLEAR}at the Pokéathlon Dome. Go on,{CLEAR}quench your thirst!

strings.zh: 阿金『哎？没时间吗……
strings.en: Gold: Huh? No time...?

strings.zh: 阿金『好嘞,阿金的第二次特训对战,{NEWLINE}现在开始！
strings.en: Gold: All right! Gold’s second training{NEWLINE}battle starts now!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像如果没事的话,{NEWLINE}再陪我练习一次呗。
strings.en: Gold: Idol, if you’re not busy,{NEWLINE}practice with me one more time.

strings.zh: 阿金『啊呀,每次跟偶像对战{NEWLINE}都紧张地浑身冒汗,{CLEAR}但也能感觉到自己因此提高了不少。
strings.en: Gold: Man, every time I battle you,{NEWLINE}Idol, I get so nervous I sweat buckets.{CLEAR}But I can feel I’ve gotten a lot better{CLEAR}because of it.

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,爆太郎已经是最终形态了,{NEWLINE}这样去挑战缘朱市道馆{CLEAR}一定能够顺利通过。
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh, Exbo’s reached its final{NEWLINE}form. Now I’m sure to breeze through{CLEAR}the Ecruteak Gym.
